name: OutageDeck
tagline: Check provider status and incidents before debugging
description: Check vendor-published status, active incidents, observed uptime history, and your provider stack across AI, cloud, developer, and SaaS services. Public read-only tools work without an account or API key.

install.notes: No API key is needed for public provider status, incident, and uptime tools. An optional OutageDeck account unlocks personalized stack and alert tools.
